title: Stability of Serrin-Type Overdetermined Problems for the $p$-Laplacian and Related Operators
summary: We investigate a Serrin-type overdetermined problem for the $p$-Laplacian and establish a quantitative stability estimate under suitable convexity and regularity assumptions on the domain, the solution, and the operator. Our method also applies to a class of generalized divergence-form elliptic operators.
